resources.string: Review device details and scan a QR code to describe a bug on your phone.
Review the snapshot, then open the GitHub form on your phone.
Only the details shown here enter the QR. No accounts, network addresses, serial numbers, app lists or logs.
QR code for a prefilled GitHub bug report
Check the details on the left and select Show QR code. Nothing is published automatically.
Scan with your phone. Sign in to GitHub, describe what happened and submit the issue yourself.
